fact: DZWatch reports that a follow-up meeting reviewed implementation of Algeria's National AI Strategy, which had moved from planning to execution of priority projects; meeting date not stated, so the published date 2026-09-22 is used.

DZWatch reports that specialised committees (data and infrastructure, continuous training, AI doctorate, funding, international cooperation) reported progress on the strategy's roadmap; date is the published date 2026-09-22 as the meeting date is not stated.
The Higher Education and Research ministry states that its minister chaired a coordination meeting on monitoring and implementing the national AI strategy.

The ministry states the meeting created five thematic commissions (data and infrastructure, financing, large language models, specialised AI doctorate, continuing AI training) to monitor the strategy's main axes.

El Watan reports that the interministerial meeting chaired by the higher education minister formalised a joint monitoring commission to oversee the strategy's intersectoral objectives to a set timetable.

Algérie Maintenant reports that the higher education minister chaired a first coordination meeting with ministries launching implementation of the national AI strategy, adopting priority areas and a joint roadmap.
The source reports a joint follow-up committee of representatives of the sectors concerned was formed to monitor the roadmap's stages to a set timetable.

El Moudjahid, citing a Prime Minister's office communiqué, reports a government meeting chaired by the Prime Minister examined the draft national AI strategy; action plans follow its adoption by the Council of Ministers.
APS, citing a Prime Minister's services communique, reports that on 25 May 2026 a Government meeting chaired by PM Sifi Ghrieb examined the draft ('projet de') national AI strategy.
The higher-education ministry says its 19 October 2026 working session was held as part of implementing the national artificial intelligence strategy.
The ministry names a National Commission responsible for implementing the national AI strategy, which is to sit in a joint framework with companies and public bodies drafting a 2030 roadmap.

fact: Le Jour d'Algerie, quoting a ministry communique, reports that the Minister of Higher Education and Scientific Research chaired the second coordination meeting on implementing Algeria's national AI strategy.

The ministry communique reports that five thematic commissions (data and infrastructure, financing, large language models, AI doctorate, continuing AI training) were installed around the strategy's main axes, after the first coordination meeting of 5 August set up a joint follow-up commission for the strategy's roadmap.
Digital Policy Alert says Algeria's AI Council announced the AI strategy in December 2024, covering research, innovation and infrastructure.
